steps.name: Require every bundled constituent to succeed
steps.run:
status=0
check_slot() {
  local kind="$1" pr="$2" integration="$3"
  if [[ -z "$kind" ]]; then
    [[ "$pr" == skipped && "$integration" == skipped ]] || status=1
  elif [[ "$kind" == pr ]]; then
    [[ "$pr" == success && "$integration" == skipped ]] || status=1
  elif [[ "$kind" == integration ]]; then
    [[ "$pr" == skipped && "$integration" == success ]] || status=1
  else
    status=1
  fi
}
check_slot "$SLOT1_KIND" "$SLOT1_PR" "$SLOT1_INTEGRATION"
check_slot "$SLOT2_KIND" "$SLOT2_PR" "$SLOT2_INTEGRATION"
check_slot "$SLOT3_KIND" "$SLOT3_PR" "$SLOT3_INTEGRATION"
check_slot "$SLOT4_KIND" "$SLOT4_PR" "$SLOT4_INTEGRATION"
exit "$status"

steps.name: Run shard (one test process per test binary, one test thread)
steps.run:
mkdir -p shard-out
start=$(date +%s)
crate="${{ matrix.crate }}"
features="${{ matrix.features }}"
standalone="${{ matrix.standalone }}"
args=()
if [[ "$standalone" == "true" ]]; then
  args+=(--manifest-path crates/contextdb-redb/Cargo.toml)
else
  args+=(-p "$crate")
fi
if [[ -n "$features" ]]; then
  args+=(--features "$features")
fi
maintenance=()
if [[ "$crate" == contextdb-engine && "$features" == *test-seams* ]]; then
  maintenance=(--skip paged_initial_replacement_and_reclamation_progress_under_writes::paged_initial_replacement_and_reclamation_progress_under_writes)
fi
set +e
# Execute correctness targets with the one-thread flag. Compile
# examples and benches separately; Criterion harnesses must not
# execute as part of the correctness gate.
cargo test --locked "${args[@]}" --lib --bins --tests -- --test-threads=1 "${maintenance[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "shard-out/${{ matrix.shard }}.log"
status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
if [[ "${#maintenance[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
  bash scripts/ci-maintenance-journey.sh "shard-out/${{ matrix.shard }}-maintenance" "${args[@]}"
  maintenance_status=$?
  if [[ "$status" -eq 0 ]]; then status=$maintenance_status; fi
fi
cargo test --locked "${args[@]}" --examples --benches --no-run 2>&1 | tee -a "shard-out/${{ matrix.shard }}.log"
bench_status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
if [[ "$status" -eq 0 ]]; then status=$bench_status; fi
set -e
end=$(date +%s)
echo "${{ matrix.shard }} $((end - start))s exit=$status" > "shard-out/${{ matrix.shard }}.time"
df -h / | tee -a "shard-out/${{ matrix.shard }}.time"
exit "$status"

steps.name: Require every correctness job to succeed
Disk and per-shard wall clock
steps.run:
df -h
echo "== per-shard wall clock =="
for f in shards/*/*.time; do head -n 1 "$f"; done | sort
